about.title: About

historySection.subtitle: Why This App?
body: As a jazz musician, I would say that I know about 200 tunes.
By "know", I mean that I can play the melody and chords from memory and improvise over them.
What I sometimes found is that in reality I could comfortably play about 50 of them from memory, maybe play another 50 uncomfortably, another 50 with some mistakes, and the last 50...
The issue is practice.
Certain tunes *always* come up on gigs.
And certain tunes are more fun to practice.
We tend to practice some a lot, and some almost never.
Being a nerd, I worked with spread sheets to have a way to keep track.
I started adding a field for the date/time that I last practiced it.
I then added a button for each tune to update the date/time and resort the tunes.
This app is an evolution of that concept.

instructionsSection.subtitle: How to Use This App
body: It's fairly simple.
Enter your songs.
Practice the song at the top of the list (the one you have not practiced in the longest time) and when you're done, press the "Practiced" button, and it moves to the bottom of the list.
The list is sorted with the tune you have not practiced in the longest tile will be at the top.
Tunes that are overdue for practice will be in red, things that are getting close in orange.
Green means that has not become due.
You can decide for yourself how to use it.
For me, I only put things in my list that are "done" - I know them.
I also work on things that I'm learning, but those are just a few things and I don't need to be reminded.
The list is for my "book" of tunes that I need to manage.

futureSection.subtitle: The Future
body: This is the beginning.
This is the free version of the app.
There will always be a free version of the app, but eventually there will be a more feature rich version.
I will have to charge something to cover expenses (and make a little), but will try to keep prices low.
Right now I'm leaning towards a very cheap subscription, but might consider ads or donations.
Some things that are being considered:

purposeSection.subtitle: Purpose
body: ReprMan is provided solely for tracking your musical repertoire and practice history.
If you can find a use for it that fits well with its original intended purpose (workout routines, etc.), then that is acceptable use.
You may not use this app for any other purpose.
Any attempt to subvert the authentication or authorization system is strictly prohibited.

conductSection.subtitle: Conduct
body: You agree not to engage in abusive behavior or use abusive language in connection with the app.
We do not tolerate harassment, threats, hate speech, spam, or attempts to disrupt the service.
Use of this app for any illegal activity is strictly prohibited.
Violations may result in immediate suspension or termination of your account.

inactivitySection.subtitle: Free accounts and inactivity
body: Non-paid accounts that have no login for 90 consecutive days may be closed.
When an account is closed for inactivity, all associated data may be permanently deleted.

emailUseSection.subtitle: Email use
body: Your email address will only be used for communication related to this app.
We will not sell your email or use it for marketing unrelated to ReprMan.

emailVolumeSection.subtitle: Email volume
body: We send only a minimal number of emails about the status and use of your account and the app.
Emails about your repertoire (for example, reminders about reprs that need practice) are sent only if you enable them in Settings.
You can turn those notifications off or unsubscribe from them at any time.

agreementSection.subtitle: Agreement
body: By using this app, you agree to the terms of use.
By agreeing to the terms of use, you agree that any violation will result in termination of your account, removal of your data, and non-refundable loss of any paid subscriptions.
